entities.name: Sanctuary of the Blessed Virgin of the Sorrows, Rho
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sanctuary of the Blessed Virgin of the Sorrows of Rho is a Roman Catholic Marian shrine just outside the historic center of the town of Rho, region of Lombardy, Italy. The church is under the administration of the Oblates of Saints Ambrose and Charles.
